description:
[read-only] One campaign's full picture: reach and engagement over time, per network, best and worst posts, and for paid the split by ad (with reach) and best/worst ads. `seriesBasis` says whether organic days are stored daily growth or publish-day estimates. `previousCampaign` names the campaign before it, with a compare link. A null measure means not reported.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/campaigns/{id}/analytics.)
name: get_campaign_analytics
title: Get one campaign's analytics
